illa Filioq; Pari modo eadem de re inven-

se professurum in posterum promittit.

rator, expressam addens improbationem eo-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "ff" for double s (appofuiffent, profeffurum, Conftantinopolitanum) read as ss. "appofuiffent" is transcribed as "apposuissent" and is a reading from the scan, so check it. Catchword "mine" completes the hyphenated word "no-mine" at the foot. Small orange stains and marks at the top and in the text are not printed and are left out.
